verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents an OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint that reaches multiple providers through a single URL, and says getting started takes one line of code. That strongly implies existing OpenAI SDK code can be redirected to the gateway. However, the docs say switching providers means changing the `model` and `apiKey` parameters, so the model string may also need editing beyond the base URL and key. missing for 10: an explicit documented base-URL-swap example for the OpenAI SDK, clarity on whether model names must change, independent or hands-on corroboration.
